reviews.body:
Thanks for this. I checked each default against the provider docs and they're all real breakages: Claude Haiku 3 retired on 2026-04-20, `gemini-2.0-flash-lite-001` retired on Vertex on 2026-06-01, and `gemini-2.5-flash` is now limited to existing Gemini API users (and retired on Vertex on 2026-10-20). Anyone relying on the defaults fails on the first request today.

The replacements look right. `claude-haiku-4-5` is Anthropic's documented successor to Haiku 3, and your point about newer Claude models rejecting our default `temperature=0` holds, so that move should be a separate change. `gemini-3.8-flash` is GA and the first replacement Google lists. The unit suite passes locally (906 passed), and an offline smoke run through `GeminiChatModel()` and `AnthropicChatModel()` builds the expected requests.

Non-blocking notes:
- Gemini 3.x on Vertex is only served from `global` or `us`/`eu`, not `us-central1`, so users with a regional `GOOGLE_VERTEX_LOCATION` will need to switch. A short hint in `.env.example` would help.
- The pinned litellm's bundled model map doesn't know `gemini-3.8-flash` yet, so cost is reported as 0 until litellm is bumped.
- Moving the Vertex default from Flash-Lite to Flash costs more. I think Flash is the right default for agent workloads; `gemini-3.5-flash-lite` is the cheaper replacement Google also lists.

I'll merge once CI is green.
